text.KJV: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
text.ASV: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called `to be' an apostle, separated unto the gospel of God,
text.WEB: Paul, a servant of Jesus Christ, called to be an apostle, set apart for the Good News of God,

text.KJV: (Which he had promised afore by his prophets in the holy scriptures,)
text.ASV: which he promised afore through his prophets in the holy scriptures,
text.WEB: which he promised before through his prophets in the holy Scriptures,

text.KJV: Concerning his Son Jesus Christ our Lord, which was made of the seed of David according to the flesh;
text.ASV: concerning his Son, who was born of the seed of David according to the flesh,
text.WEB: concerning his Son, who was born of the offspring of David according to the flesh,

text.KJV: And declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead:
text.ASV: who was declared `to be' the Son of God with power, according to the spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead; `even' Jesus Christ our Lord,
text.WEB: who was declared to be the Son of God with power, according to the Spirit of holiness, by the resurrection from the dead, Jesus Christ our Lord,

text.KJV: By whom we have received grace and apostleship, for obedience to the faith among all nations, for his name:
text.ASV: through whom we received grace and apostleship, unto obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name's sake;
text.WEB: through whom we received grace and apostleship, for obedience of faith among all the nations, for his name’s sake;

text.KJV: Among whom are ye also the called of Jesus Christ:
text.ASV: among whom are ye also called `to be' Jesus Christ's:
text.WEB: among whom you are also called to belong to Jesus Christ;

text.KJV: To all that be in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father, and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: To all that are in Rome, beloved of God, called `to be' saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: to all who are in Rome, beloved of God, called to be saints: Grace to you and peace from God our Father and the Lord Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is spoken of throughout the whole world.
text.ASV: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for you all, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.
text.WEB: First, I thank my God through Jesus Christ for all of you, that your faith is proclaimed throughout the whole world.

text.KJV: For God is my witness, whom I serve with my spirit in the gospel of his Son, that without ceasing I make mention of you always in my prayers;
text.ASV: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the gospel of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you, always in my prayers
text.WEB: For God is my witness, whom I serve in my spirit in the Good News of his Son, how unceasingly I make mention of you always in my prayers,

text.KJV: Making request, if by any means now at length I might have a prosperous journey by the will of God to come unto you.
text.ASV: making request, if by any means now at length I may be prospered by the will of God to come unto you.
text.WEB: requesting, if by any means now at last I may be prospered by the will of God to come to you.

text.KJV: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
text.ASV: For I long to see you, that I may impart unto you some spiritual gift, to the end ye may be established;
text.WEB: For I long to see you, that I may impart to you some spiritual gift, to the end that you may be established;

text.KJV: That is, that I may be comforted together with you by the mutual faith both of you and me.
text.ASV: that is, that I with you may be comforted in you, each of us by the other's faith, both yours and mine.
text.WEB: that is, that I with you may be encouraged in you, each of us by the other’s faith, both yours and mine.

text.KJV: Now I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you, (but was let hitherto,) that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among other Gentiles.
text.ASV: And I would not have you ignorant, brethren, that oftentimes I purposed to come unto you (and was hindered hitherto), that I might have some fruit in you also, even as in the rest of the Gentiles.
text.WEB: Now I don’t desire to have you unaware, brothers, that I often planned to come to you, and was hindered so far, that I might have some fruit among you also, even as among the rest of the Gentiles.

text.KJV: I am debtor both to the Greeks, and to the Barbarians; both to the wise, and to the unwise.
text.ASV: I am debtor both to Greeks and to Barbarians, both to the wise and to the foolish.
text.WEB: I am debtor both to Greeks and to foreigners, both to the wise and to the foolish.

text.KJV: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you that are at Rome also.
text.ASV: So, as much as in me is, I am ready to preach the gospel to you also that are in Rome.
text.WEB: So, as much as is in me, I am eager to preach the Good News to you also who are in Rome.

text.KJV: For I am not ashamed of the gospel of Christ: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
text.ASV: For I am not ashamed of the gospel: for it is the power of God unto salvation to every one that believeth; to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.
text.WEB: For I am not ashamed of the Good News of Christ, because it is the power of God for salvation for everyone who believes; for the Jew first, and also for the Greek.

text.KJV: For therein is the righteousness of God revealed from faith to faith: as it is written, The just shall live by faith.
text.ASV: For therein is revealed a righteousness of God from faith unto faith: as it is written, But the righteous shall live by faith.
text.WEB: For in it is revealed God’s righteousness from faith to faith. As it is written, “But the righteous shall live by faith.”

text.KJV: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hold the truth in unrighteousness;
text.ASV: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who hinder the truth in unrighteousness;
text.WEB: For the wrath of God is revealed from heaven against all ungodliness and unrighteousness of men, who suppress the truth in unrighteousness,

text.KJV: Because that which may be known of God is manifest in them; for God hath shewed it unto them.
text.ASV: because that which is known of God is manifest in them; for God manifested it unto them.
text.WEB: because that which is known of God is revealed in them, for God revealed it to them.

text.KJV: For the invisible things of him from the creation of the world are clearly seen, being understood by the things that are made, even his eternal power and Godhead; so that they are without excuse:
text.ASV: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, `even' his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse:
text.WEB: For the invisible things of him since the creation of the world are clearly seen, being perceived through the things that are made, even his everlasting power and divinity; that they may be without excuse.

text.KJV: Because that, when they knew God, they glorified him not as God, neither were thankful; but became vain in their imaginations, and their foolish heart was darkened.
text.ASV: because that, knowing God, they glorified him not as God, neither gave thanks; but became vain in their reasonings, and their senseless heart was darkened.
text.WEB: Because, knowing God, they didn’t glorify him as God, neither gave thanks, but became vain in their reasoning, and their senseless heart was darkened.

text.KJV: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
text.ASV: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,
text.WEB: Professing themselves to be wise, they became fools,

text.KJV: And changed the glory of the uncorruptible God into an image made like to corruptible man, and to birds, and fourfooted beasts, and creeping things.
text.ASV: and changed the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed beasts, and creeping things.
text.WEB: and traded the glory of the incorruptible God for the likeness of an image of corruptible man, and of birds, and four-footed animals, and creeping things.

text.KJV: Wherefore God also gave them up to uncleanness through the lusts of their own hearts, to dishonour their own bodies between themselves:
text.ASV: Wherefore God gave them up in the lusts of their hearts unto uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves:
text.WEB: Therefore God also gave them up in the lusts of their hearts to uncleanness, that their bodies should be dishonored among themselves;

text.KJV: Who changed the truth of God into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
text.ASV: for that they exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshipped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.
text.WEB: who exchanged the truth of God for a lie, and worshiped and served the creature rather than the Creator, who is blessed forever. Amen.

text.KJV: For this cause God gave them up unto vile affections: for even their women did change the natural use into that which is against nature:
text.ASV: For this cause God gave them up unto vile passions: for their women changed the natural use into that which is against nature:
text.WEB: For this reason, God gave them up to vile passions. For their women changed the natural function into that which is against nature.

text.KJV: And likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another; men with men working that which is unseemly, and receiving in themselves that recompence of their error which was meet.
text.ASV: and likewise also the men, leaving the natural use of the woman, burned in their lust one toward another, men with men working unseemliness, and receiving in themselves that recompense of their error which was due.
text.WEB: Likewise also the men, leaving the natural function of the woman, burned in their lust toward one another, men doing what is inappropriate with men, and receiving in themselves the due penalty of their error.

text.KJV: And even as they did not like to retain God in their knowledge, God gave them over to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not convenient;
text.ASV: And even as they refused to have God in `their' knowledge, God gave them up unto a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;
text.WEB: Even as they refused to have God in their knowledge, God gave them up to a reprobate mind, to do those things which are not fitting;

text.KJV: Being filled with all unrighteousness, fornication, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, debate, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
text.ASV: being filled with all unrighteousness, wickedness, covetousness, maliciousness; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, malignity; whisperers,
text.WEB: being filled with all unrighteousness, sexual immorality, wickedness, covetousness, malice; full of envy, murder, strife, deceit, evil habits, secret slanderers,

text.KJV: Backbiters, haters of God, despiteful, proud, boasters, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
text.ASV: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,
text.WEB: backbiters, hateful to God, insolent, haughty, boastful, inventors of evil things, disobedient to parents,

text.KJV: Without understanding, covenantbreakers, without natural affection, implacable, unmerciful:
text.ASV: without understanding, covenant-breakers, without natural affection, unmerciful:
text.WEB: without understanding, covenant breakers, without natural affection, unforgiving, unmerciful;

text.KJV: Who knowing the judgment of God, that they which commit such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but have pleasure in them that do them.
text.ASV: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that they that practise such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also consent with them that practise them.
text.WEB: who, knowing the ordinance of God, that those who practice such things are worthy of death, not only do the same, but also approve of those who practice them.

text.KJV: Therefore thou art inexcusable, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judgest another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest doest the same things.
text.ASV: Wherefore thou art without excuse, O man, whosoever thou art that judgest: for wherein thou judges another, thou condemnest thyself; for thou that judgest dost practise the same things.
text.WEB: Therefore you are without excuse, O man, whoever you are who judge. For in that which you judge another, you condemn yourself. For you who judge practice the same things.

text.KJV: But we are sure that the judgment of God is according to truth against them which commit such things.
text.ASV: And we know that the judgment of God is according to truth against them that practise such things.
text.WEB: We know that the judgment of God is according to truth against those who practice such things.

text.KJV: And thinkest thou this, O man, that judgest them which do such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
text.ASV: And reckonest thou this, O man, who judgest them that practise such things, and doest the same, that thou shalt escape the judgment of God?
text.WEB: Do you think this, O man who judges those who practice such things, and do the same, that you will escape the judgment of God?

text.KJV: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering; not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
text.ASV: Or despisest thou the riches of his goodness and forbearance and longsuffering, not knowing that the goodness of God leadeth thee to repentance?
text.WEB: Or do you despise the riches of his goodness, forbearance, and patience, not knowing that the goodness of God leads you to repentance?

text.KJV: But after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up unto thyself wrath against the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
text.ASV: but after thy hardness and impenitent heart treasurest up for thyself wrath in the day of wrath and revelation of the righteous judgment of God;
text.WEB: But according to your hardness and unrepentant heart you are treasuring up for yourself wrath in the day of wrath, revelation, and of the righteous judgment of God;

text.KJV: Who will render to every man according to his deeds:
text.ASV: who will render to every man according to his works:
text.WEB: who “will pay back to everyone according to their works:”;

text.KJV: To them who by patient continuance in well doing seek for glory and honour and immortality, eternal life:
text.ASV: to them that by patience in well-doing seek for glory and honor and incorruption, eternal life:
text.WEB: to those who by perseverance in well-doing seek for glory, honor, and incorruptibility, eternal life;

text.KJV: But unto them that are contentious, and do not obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, indignation and wrath,
text.ASV: but unto them that are factious, and obey not the truth, but obey unrighteousness, `shall be' wrath and indignation,
text.WEB: but to those who are self-seeking, and don’t obey the truth, but obey unrighteousness, will be wrath and indignation,

text.KJV: Tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that doeth evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Gentile;
text.ASV: tribulation and anguish, upon every soul of man that worketh evil, of the Jew first, and also of the Greek;
text.WEB: oppression and anguish, on every soul of man who does evil, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

text.KJV: But glory, honour, and peace, to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Gentile:
text.ASV: but glory and honor and peace to every man that worketh good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek:
text.WEB: But glory, honor, and peace go to every man who does good, to the Jew first, and also to the Greek.

text.KJV: For there is no respect of persons with God.
text.ASV: for there is no respect of persons with God.
text.WEB: For there is no partiality with God.

text.KJV: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without law: and as many as have sinned in the law shall be judged by the law;
text.ASV: For as many as have sinned without law shall also perish without the law: and as many as have sinned under the law shall be judged by the law;
text.WEB: For as many as have sinned without the law will also perish without the law. As many as have sinned under the law will be judged by the law.

text.KJV: (For not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified.
text.ASV: for not the hearers of the law are just before God, but the doers of the law shall be justified:
text.WEB: For it isn’t the hearers of the law who are righteous before God, but the doers of the law will be justified

text.KJV: For when the Gentiles, which have not the law, do by nature the things contained in the law, these, having not the law, are a law unto themselves:
text.ASV: (for when Gentiles that have not the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are the law unto themselves;
text.WEB: (for when Gentiles who don’t have the law do by nature the things of the law, these, not having the law, are a law to themselves,

text.KJV: Which shew the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience also bearing witness, and their thoughts the mean while accusing or else excusing one another;)
text.ASV: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience bearing witness therewith, and their thoughts one with another accusing or else excusing `them');
text.WEB: in that they show the work of the law written in their hearts, their conscience testifying with them, and their thoughts among themselves accusing or else excusing them)

text.KJV: In the day when God shall judge the secrets of men by Jesus Christ according to my gospel.
text.ASV: in the day when God shall judge the secrets of men, according to my gospel, by Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: in the day when God will judge the secrets of men, according to my Good News, by Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: Behold, thou art called a Jew, and restest in the law, and makest thy boast of God,
text.ASV: But if thou bearest the name of a Jew, and restest upon the law, and gloriest in God,
text.WEB: Indeed you bear the name of a Jew, and rest on the law, and glory in God,

text.KJV: And knowest his will, and approvest the things that are more excellent, being instructed out of the law;
text.ASV: and knowest his will, and approvest the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,
text.WEB: and know his will, and approve the things that are excellent, being instructed out of the law,

text.KJV: And art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them which are in darkness,
text.ASV: and art confident that thou thyself art a guide of the blind, a light of them that are in darkness,
text.WEB: and are confident that you yourself are a guide of the blind, a light to those who are in darkness,

text.KJV: An instructor of the foolish, a teacher of babes, which hast the form of knowledge and of the truth in the law.
text.ASV: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babes, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth;
text.WEB: a corrector of the foolish, a teacher of babies, having in the law the form of knowledge and of the truth.

text.KJV: Thou therefore which teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
text.ASV: thou therefore that teachest another, teachest thou not thyself? thou that preachest a man should not steal, dost thou steal?
text.WEB: You therefore who teach another, don’t you teach yourself? You who preach that a man shouldn’t steal, do you steal?

text.KJV: Thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou commit sacrilege?
text.ASV: thou that sayest a man should not commit adultery, dost thou commit adultery? thou that abhorrest idols, dost thou rob temples?
text.WEB: You who say a man shouldn’t commit adultery. Do you commit adultery? You who abhor idols, do you rob temples?

text.KJV: Thou that makest thy boast of the law, through breaking the law dishonourest thou God?
text.ASV: thou who gloriest in the law, through thy transgression of the law dishonorest thou God?
text.WEB: You who glory in the law, do you dishonor God by disobeying the law?

text.KJV: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles through you, as it is written.
text.ASV: For the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you, even as it is written.
text.WEB: For “the name of God is blasphemed among the Gentiles because of you,” ; just as it is written.

text.KJV: For circumcision verily profiteth, if thou keep the law: but if thou be a breaker of the law, thy circumcision is made uncircumcision.
text.ASV: For circumcision indeed profiteth, if thou be a doer of the law: but if thou be a transgressor of the law, thy circumcision is become uncircumcision.
text.WEB: For circumcision indeed profits, if you are a doer of the law, but if you are a transgressor of the law, your circumcision has become uncircumcision.

text.KJV: Therefore if the uncircumcision keep the righteousness of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be counted for circumcision?
text.ASV: If therefore the uncircumcision keep the ordinances of the law, shall not his uncircumcision be reckoned for circumcision?
text.WEB: If therefore the uncircumcised keep the ordinances of the law, won’t his uncircumcision be accounted as circumcision?

text.KJV: And shall not uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who by the letter and circumcision dost transgress the law?
text.ASV: and shall not the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfil the law, judge thee, who with the letter and circumcision art a transgressor of the law?
text.WEB: Won’t the uncircumcision which is by nature, if it fulfills the law, judge you, who with the letter and circumcision are a transgressor of the law?

text.KJV: For he is not a Jew, which is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision, which is outward in the flesh:
text.ASV: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly; neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh:
text.WEB: For he is not a Jew who is one outwardly, neither is that circumcision which is outward in the flesh;

text.KJV: But he is a Jew, which is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit, and not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
text.ASV: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly; and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not of men, but of God.
text.WEB: but he is a Jew who is one inwardly, and circumcision is that of the heart, in the spirit not in the letter; whose praise is not from men, but from God.

text.KJV: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what profit is there of circumcision?
text.ASV: What advantage then hath the Jew? or what is the profit of circumcision?
text.WEB: Then what advantage does the Jew have? Or what is the profit of circumcision?

text.KJV: Much every way: chiefly, because that unto them were committed the oracles of God.
text.ASV: Much every way: first of all, that they were intrusted with the oracles of God.
text.WEB: Much in every way! Because first of all, they were entrusted with the revelations of God.

text.KJV: For what if some did not believe? shall their unbelief make the faith of God without effect?
text.ASV: For what if some were without faith? shall their want of faith make of none effect the faithfulness of God?
text.WEB: For what if some were without faith? Will their lack of faith nullify the faithfulness of God?

text.KJV: God forbid: yea, let God be true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy sayings, and mightest overcome when thou art judged.
text.ASV: God forbid: yea, let God be found true, but every man a liar; as it is written, That thou mightest be justified in thy words, And mightest prevail when thou comest into judgment.
text.WEB: May it never be! Yes, let God be found true, but every man a liar. As it is written, “That you might be justified in your words, and might prevail when you come into judgment.”

text.KJV: But if our unrighteousness commend the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who taketh vengeance? (I speak as a man)
text.ASV: But if our righteousness commendeth the righteousness of God, what shall we say? Is God unrighteous who visiteth with wrath? (I speak after the manner of men.)
text.WEB: But if our unrighteousness commends the righteousness of God, what will we say? Is God unrighteous who inflicts wrath? I speak like men do.

text.KJV: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
text.ASV: God forbid: for then how shall God judge the world?
text.WEB: May it never be! For then how will God judge the world?

text.KJV: For if the truth of God hath more abounded through my lie unto his glory; why yet am I also judged as a sinner?
text.ASV: But if the truth of God through my lie abounded unto his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?
text.WEB: For if the truth of God through my lie abounded to his glory, why am I also still judged as a sinner?

text.KJV: And not rather, (as we be slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say,) Let us do evil, that good may come? whose damnation is just.
text.ASV: and why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), Let us do evil, that good may come? whose condemnation is just.
text.WEB: Why not (as we are slanderously reported, and as some affirm that we say), “Let us do evil, that good may come?” Those who say so are justly condemned.

text.KJV: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we have before proved both Jews and Gentiles, that they are all under sin;
text.ASV: What then? are we better than they? No, in no wise: for we before laid to the charge both of Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin;
text.WEB: What then? Are we better than they? No, in no way. For we previously warned both Jews and Greeks, that they are all under sin.

text.KJV: As it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one:
text.ASV: as it is written, There is none righteous, no, not one;
text.WEB: As it is written, “There is no one righteous; no, not one.

text.KJV: There is none that understandeth, there is none that seeketh after God.
text.ASV: There is none that understandeth, There is none that seeketh after God;
text.WEB: There is no one who understands. There is no one who seeks after God.

text.KJV: They are all gone out of the way, they are together become unprofitable; there is none that doeth good, no, not one.
text.ASV: They have all turned aside, they are together become unprofitable; There is none that doeth good, no, not, so much as one:
text.WEB: They have all turned away. They have together become unprofitable. There is no one who does good, no, not so much as one.”; ;

text.KJV: Their throat is an open sepulchre; with their tongues they have used deceit; the poison of asps is under their lips:
text.ASV: Their throat is an open sepulchre; With their tongues they have used deceit: The poison of asps is under their lips:
text.WEB: “Their throat is an open tomb. With their tongues they have used deceit.” “The poison of vipers is under their lips”;

text.KJV: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
text.ASV: Whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness:
text.WEB: “whose mouth is full of cursing and bitterness.”

text.KJV: Their feet are swift to shed blood:
text.ASV: Their feet are swift to shed blood;
text.WEB: “Their feet are swift to shed blood.

text.KJV: Destruction and misery are in their ways:
text.ASV: Destruction and misery are in their ways;
text.WEB: Destruction and misery are in their ways.

text.KJV: And the way of peace have they not known:
text.ASV: And the way of peace have they not known:
text.WEB: The way of peace, they haven’t known.”

text.KJV: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
text.ASV: There is no fear of God before their eyes.
text.WEB: “There is no fear of God before their eyes.”

text.KJV: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it saith to them who are under the law: that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may become guilty before God.
text.ASV: Now we know that what things soever the law saith, it speaketh to them that are under the law; that every mouth may be stopped, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God:
text.WEB: Now we know that whatever things the law says, it speaks to those who are under the law, that every mouth may be closed, and all the world may be brought under the judgment of God.

text.KJV: Therefore by the deeds of the law there shall no flesh be justified in his sight: for by the law is the knowledge of sin.
text.ASV: because by the works of the law shall no flesh be justified in his sight; for through the law `cometh' the knowledge of sin.
text.WEB: Because by the works of the law, no flesh will be justified in his sight. For through the law comes the knowledge of sin.

text.KJV: But now the righteousness of God without the law is manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
text.ASV: But now apart from the law a righteousness of God hath been manifested, being witnessed by the law and the prophets;
text.WEB: But now apart from the law, a righteousness of God has been revealed, being testified by the law and the prophets;

text.KJV: Even the righteousness of God which is by faith of Jesus Christ unto all and upon all them that believe: for there is no difference:
text.ASV: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ unto all them that believe; for there is no distinction;
text.WEB: even the righteousness of God through faith in Jesus Christ to all and on all those who believe. For there is no distinction,

text.KJV: For all have sinned, and come short of the glory of God;
text.ASV: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;
text.WEB: for all have sinned, and fall short of the glory of God;

text.KJV: Being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
text.ASV: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus:
text.WEB: being justified freely by his grace through the redemption that is in Christ Jesus;

text.KJV: Whom God hath set forth to be a propitiation through faith in his blood, to declare his righteousness for the remission of sins that are past, through the forbearance of God;
text.ASV: whom God set forth `to be' a propitiation, through faith, in his blood, to show his righteousness because of the passing over of the sins done aforetime, in the forbearance of God;
text.WEB: whom God sent to be an atoning sacrifice, through faith in his blood, for a demonstration of his righteousness through the passing over of prior sins, in God’s forbearance;

text.KJV: To declare, I say, at this time his righteousness: that he might be just, and the justifier of him which believeth in Jesus.
text.ASV: for the showing, `I say', of his righteousness at this present season: that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him that hath faith in Jesus.
text.WEB: to demonstrate his righteousness at this present time; that he might himself be just, and the justifier of him who has faith in Jesus.

text.KJV: Where is boasting then? It is excluded. By what law? of works? Nay: but by the law of faith.
text.ASV: Where then is the glorying? It is excluded. By what manner of law? of works? Nay: but by a law of faith.
text.WEB: Where then is the boasting? It is excluded. By what kind of law? Of works? No, but by a law of faith.

text.KJV: Therefore we conclude that a man is justified by faith without the deeds of the law.
text.ASV: We reckon therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.
text.WEB: We maintain therefore that a man is justified by faith apart from the works of the law.

text.KJV: Is he the God of the Jews only? is he not also of the Gentiles? Yes, of the Gentiles also:
text.ASV: Or is God `the God' of Jews only? is he not `the God' of Gentiles also? Yea, of Gentiles also:
text.WEB: Or is God the God of Jews only? Isn’t he the God of Gentiles also? Yes, of Gentiles also,

text.KJV: Seeing it is one God, which shall justify the circumcision by faith, and uncircumcision through faith.
text.ASV: if so be that God is one, and he shall justify the circumcision by faith, and the uncircumcision through faith.
text.WEB: since indeed there is one God who will justify the circumcised by faith, and the uncircumcised through faith.

text.KJV: Do we then make void the law through faith? God forbid: yea, we establish the law.
text.ASV: Do we then make the law of none effect through faith? God forbid: nay, we establish the law.
text.WEB: Do we then nullify the law through faith? May it never be! No, we establish the law.

text.KJV: What shall we say then that Abraham our father, as pertaining to the flesh, hath found?
text.ASV: What then shall we say that Abraham, our forefather, hath found according to the flesh?
text.WEB: What then will we say that Abraham, our forefather, has found according to the flesh?

text.KJV: For if Abraham were justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not before God.
text.ASV: For if Abraham was justified by works, he hath whereof to glory; but not toward God.
text.WEB: For if Abraham was justified by works, he has something to boast about, but not toward God.

text.KJV: For what saith the scripture? Abraham believed God, and it was counted unto him for righteousness.
text.ASV: For what saith the scripture? And Abraham believed God, and it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
text.WEB: For what does the Scripture say? “Abraham believed God, and it was accounted to him for righteousness.”

text.KJV: Now to him that worketh is the reward not reckoned of grace, but of debt.
text.ASV: Now to him that worketh, the reward is not reckoned as of grace, but as of debt.
text.WEB: Now to him who works, the reward is not counted as grace, but as something owed.

text.KJV: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is counted for righteousness.
text.ASV: But to him that worketh not, but believeth on him that justifieth the ungodly, his faith is reckoned for righteousness.
text.WEB: But to him who doesn’t work, but believes in him who justifies the ungodly, his faith is accounted for righteousness.

text.KJV: Even as David also describeth the blessedness of the man, unto whom God imputeth righteousness without works,
text.ASV: Even as David also pronounceth blessing upon the man, unto whom God reckoneth righteousness apart from works,
text.WEB: Even as David also pronounces blessing on the man to whom God counts righteousness apart from works,

text.KJV: Saying, Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, and whose sins are covered.
text.ASV: `saying', Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, And whose sins are covered.
text.WEB: “Blessed are they whose iniquities are forgiven, whose sins are covered.

text.KJV: Blessed is the man to whom the Lord will not impute sin.
text.ASV: Blessed is the man to whom, the Lord will not reckon sin.
text.WEB: Blessed is the man whom the Lord will by no means charge with sin.”

text.KJV: Cometh this blessedness then upon the circumcision only, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say that faith was reckoned to Abraham for righteousness.
text.ASV: Is this blessing then pronounced upon the circumcision, or upon the uncircumcision also? for we say, To Abraham his faith was reckoned for righteousness.
text.WEB: Is this blessing then pronounced on the circumcised, or on the uncircumcised also? For we say that faith was accounted to Abraham for righteousness.

text.KJV: How was it then reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.
text.ASV: How then was it reckoned? when he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision:
text.WEB: How then was it counted? When he was in circumcision, or in uncircumcision? Not in circumcision, but in uncircumcision.

text.KJV: And he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had yet being uncircumcised: that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be not circumcised; that righteousness might be imputed unto them also:
text.ASV: and he received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision; that he might be the father of all them that believe, though they be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might be reckoned unto them;
text.WEB: He received the sign of circumcision, a seal of the righteousness of the faith which he had while he was in uncircumcision, that he might be the father of all those who believe, though they might be in uncircumcision, that righteousness might also be accounted to them.

text.KJV: And the father of circumcision to them who are not of the circumcision only, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had being yet uncircumcised.
text.ASV: and the father of circumcision to them who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham which he had in uncircumcision.
text.WEB: He is the father of circumcision to those who not only are of the circumcision, but who also walk in the steps of that faith of our father Abraham, which he had in uncircumcision.

text.KJV: For the promise, that he should be the heir of the world, was not to Abraham, or to his seed, through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.
text.ASV: For not through the law was the promise to Abraham or to his seed that he should be heir of the world, but through the righteousness of faith.
text.WEB: For the promise to Abraham and to his offspring that he should be heir of the world wasn’t through the law, but through the righteousness of faith.

text.KJV: For if they which are of the law be heirs, faith is made void, and the promise made of none effect:
text.ASV: For if they that are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of none effect:
text.WEB: For if those who are of the law are heirs, faith is made void, and the promise is made of no effect.

text.KJV: Because the law worketh wrath: for where no law is, there is no transgression.
text.ASV: for the law worketh wrath; but where there is no law, neither is there transgression.
text.WEB: For the law produces wrath, for where there is no law, neither is there disobedience.

text.KJV: Therefore it is of faith, that it might be by grace; to the end the promise might be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham; who is the father of us all,
text.ASV: For this cause `it is' of faith, that `it may be' according to grace; to the end that the promise may be sure to all the seed; not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all
text.WEB: For this cause it is of faith, that it may be according to grace, to the end that the promise may be sure to all the offspring, not to that only which is of the law, but to that also which is of the faith of Abraham, who is the father of us all.

text.KJV: (As it is written, I have made thee a father of many nations,) before him whom he believed, even God, who quickeneth the dead, and calleth those things which be not as though they were.
text.ASV: (as it is written, A father of many nations have I made thee) before him whom he believed, `even' God, who giveth life to the dead, and calleth the things that are not, as though they were.
text.WEB: As it is written, “I have made you a father of many nations.” This is in the presence of him whom he believed: God, who gives life to the dead, and calls the things that are not, as though they were.

text.KJV: Who against hope believed in hope, that he might become the father of many nations, according to that which was spoken, So shall thy seed be.
text.ASV: Who in hope believed against hope, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, So shall thy seed be.
text.WEB: Besides hope, Abraham in hope believed, to the end that he might become a father of many nations, according to that which had been spoken, “So will your offspring be.”

text.KJV: And being not weak in faith, he considered not his own body now dead, when he was about an hundred years old, neither yet the deadness of Sarah's womb:
text.ASV: And without being weakened in faith he considered his own body now as good as dead (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah's womb;
text.WEB: Without being weakened in faith, he didn’t consider his own body, already having been worn out, (he being about a hundred years old), and the deadness of Sarah’s womb.

text.KJV: He staggered not at the promise of God through unbelief; but was strong in faith, giving glory to God;
text.ASV: yet, looking unto the promise of God, he wavered not through unbelief, but waxed strong through faith, giving glory to God,
text.WEB: Yet, looking to the promise of God, he didn’t waver through unbelief, but grew strong through faith, giving glory to God,

text.KJV: And being fully persuaded that, what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
text.ASV: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was able also to perform.
text.WEB: and being fully assured that what he had promised, he was also able to perform.

text.KJV: And therefore it was imputed to him for righteousness.
text.ASV: Wherefore also it was reckoned unto him for righteousness.
text.WEB: Therefore it also was “credited to him for righteousness.”

text.KJV: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was imputed to him;
text.ASV: Now it was not written for his sake alone, that it was reckoned unto him;
text.WEB: Now it was not written that it was accounted to him for his sake alone,

text.KJV: But for us also, to whom it shall be imputed, if we believe on him that raised up Jesus our Lord from the dead;
text.ASV: but for our sake also, unto whom it shall be reckoned, who believe on him that raised Jesus our Lord from the dead,
text.WEB: but for our sake also, to whom it will be accounted, who believe in him who raised Jesus, our Lord, from the dead,

text.KJV: Who was delivered for our offences, and was raised again for our justification.
text.ASV: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.
text.WEB: who was delivered up for our trespasses, and was raised for our justification.

text.KJV: Therefore being justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ:
text.ASV: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;
text.WEB: Being therefore justified by faith, we have peace with God through our Lord Jesus Christ;

text.KJV: By whom also we have access by faith into this grace wherein we stand, and rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
text.ASV: through whom also we have had our access by faith into this grace wherein we stand; and we rejoice in hope of the glory of God.
text.WEB: through whom we also have our access by faith into this grace in which we stand. We rejoice in hope of the glory of God.

text.KJV: And not only so, but we glory in tribulations also: knowing that tribulation worketh patience;
text.ASV: And not only so, but we also rejoice in our tribulations: knowing that tribulation worketh stedfastness;
text.WEB: Not only this, but we also rejoice in our sufferings, knowing that suffering produces perseverance;

text.KJV: And patience, experience; and experience, hope:
text.ASV: and stedfastness, approvedness; and approvedness, hope:
text.WEB: and perseverance, proven character; and proven character, hope:

text.KJV: And hope maketh not ashamed; because the love of God is shed abroad in our hearts by the Holy Ghost which is given unto us.
text.ASV: and hope putteth not to shame; because the love of God hath been shed abroad in our hearts through the Holy Spirit which was given unto us.
text.WEB: and hope doesn’t disappoint us, because God’s love has been poured out into our hearts through the Holy Spirit who was given to us.

text.KJV: For when we were yet without strength, in due time Christ died for the ungodly.
text.ASV: For while we were yet weak, in due season Christ died for the ungodly.
text.WEB: For while we were yet weak, at the right time Christ died for the ungodly.

text.KJV: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: yet peradventure for a good man some would even dare to die.
text.ASV: For scarcely for a righteous man will one die: for peradventure for the good man some one would even dare to die.
text.WEB: For one will hardly die for a righteous man. Yet perhaps for a righteous person someone would even dare to die.

text.KJV: But God commendeth his love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
text.ASV: But God commendeth his own love toward us, in that, while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.
text.WEB: But God commends his own love toward us, in that while we were yet sinners, Christ died for us.

text.KJV: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we shall be saved from wrath through him.
text.ASV: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, shall we be saved from the wrath `of God' through him.
text.WEB: Much more then, being now justified by his blood, we will be saved from God’s wrath through him.

text.KJV: For if, when we were enemies, we were reconciled to God by the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we shall be saved by his life.
text.ASV: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, shall we be saved by his life;
text.WEB: For if, while we were enemies, we were reconciled to God through the death of his Son, much more, being reconciled, we will be saved by his life.

text.KJV: And not only so, but we also joy in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, by whom we have now received the atonement.
text.ASV: and not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.
text.WEB: Not only so, but we also rejoice in God through our Lord Jesus Christ, through whom we have now received the reconciliation.

text.KJV: Wherefore, as by one man sin entered into the world, and death by sin; and so death passed upon all men, for that all have sinned:
text.ASV: Therefore, as through one man sin entered into the world, and death through sin; and so death passed unto all men, for that all sinned:--
text.WEB: Therefore as sin entered into the world through one man, and death through sin; and so death passed to all men, because all sinned.

text.KJV: (For until the law sin was in the world: but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
text.ASV: for until the law sin was in the world; but sin is not imputed when there is no law.
text.WEB: For until the law, sin was in the world; but sin is not charged when there is no law.

text.KJV: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam to Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the similitude of Adam's transgression, who is the figure of him that was to come.
text.ASV: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over them that had not sinned after the likeness of Adam's transgression, who is a figure of him that was to come.
text.WEB: Nevertheless death reigned from Adam until Moses, even over those whose sins weren’t like Adam’s disobedience, who is a foreshadowing of him who was to come.

text.KJV: But not as the offence, so also is the free gift. For if through the offence of one many be dead, much more the grace of God, and the gift by grace, which is by one man, Jesus Christ, hath abounded unto many.
text.ASV: But not as the trespass, so also `is' the free gift. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound unto the many.
text.WEB: But the free gift isn’t like the trespass. For if by the trespass of the one the many died, much more did the grace of God, and the gift by the grace of the one man, Jesus Christ, abound to the many.

text.KJV: And not as it was by one that sinned, so is the gift: for the judgment was by one to condemnation, but the free gift is of many offences unto justification.
text.ASV: And not as through one that sinned, `so' is the gift: for the judgment `came' of one unto condemnation, but the free gift `came' of many trespasses unto justification.
text.WEB: The gift is not as through one who sinned: for the judgment came by one to condemnation, but the free gift came of many trespasses to justification.

text.KJV: For if by one man's offence death reigned by one; much more they which receive abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness shall reign in life by one, Jesus Christ.)
text.ASV: For if, by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; much more shall they that receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, `even' Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: For if by the trespass of the one, death reigned through the one; so much more will those who receive the abundance of grace and of the gift of righteousness reign in life through the one, Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: Therefore as by the offence of one judgment came upon all men to condemnation; even so by the righteousness of one the free gift came upon all men unto justification of life.
text.ASV: So then as through one trespass `the judgment came' unto all men to condemnation; even so through one act of righteousness `the free gift came' unto all men to justification of life.
text.WEB: So then as through one trespass, all men were condemned; even so through one act of righteousness, all men were justified to life.

text.KJV: For as by one man's disobedience many were made sinners, so by the obedience of one shall many be made righteous.
text.ASV: For as through the one man's disobedience the many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one shall the many be made righteous.
text.WEB: For as through the one man’s disobedience many were made sinners, even so through the obedience of the one, many will be made righteous.

text.KJV: Moreover the law entered, that the offence might abound. But where sin abounded, grace did much more abound:
text.ASV: And the law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace did abound more exceedingly:
text.WEB: The law came in besides, that the trespass might abound; but where sin abounded, grace abounded more exceedingly;

text.KJV: That as sin hath reigned unto death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life by Jesus Christ our Lord.
text.ASV: that, as sin reigned in death, even so might grace reign through righteousness unto eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
text.WEB: that as sin reigned in death, even so grace might reign through righteousness to eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.

text.KJV: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
text.ASV: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?
text.WEB: What shall we say then? Shall we continue in sin, that grace may abound?

text.KJV: God forbid. How shall we, that are dead to sin, live any longer therein?
text.ASV: God forbid. We who died to sin, how shall we any longer live therein?
text.WEB: May it never be! We who died to sin, how could we live in it any longer?

text.KJV: Know ye not, that so many of us as were baptized into Jesus Christ were baptized into his death?
text.ASV: Or are ye ignorant that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?
text.WEB: Or don’t you know that all we who were baptized into Christ Jesus were baptized into his death?

text.KJV: Therefore we are buried with him by baptism into death: that like as Christ was raised up from the dead by the glory of the Father, even so we also should walk in newness of life.
text.ASV: We were buried therefore with him through baptism unto death: that like as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.
text.WEB: We were buried therefore with him through baptism into death, that just as Christ was raised from the dead through the glory of the Father, so we also might walk in newness of life.

text.KJV: For if we have been planted together in the likeness of his death, we shall be also in the likeness of his resurrection:
text.ASV: For if we have become united with `him' in the likeness of his death, we shall be also `in the likeness' of his resurrection;
text.WEB: For if we have become united with him in the likeness of his death, we will also be part of his resurrection;

text.KJV: Knowing this, that our old man is crucified with him, that the body of sin might be destroyed, that henceforth we should not serve sin.
text.ASV: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with `him', that the body of sin might be done away, that so we should no longer be in bondage to sin;
text.WEB: knowing this, that our old man was crucified with him, that the body of sin might be done away with, so that we would no longer be in bondage to sin.

text.KJV: For he that is dead is freed from sin.
text.ASV: for he that hath died is justified from sin.
text.WEB: For he who has died has been freed from sin.

text.KJV: Now if we be dead with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him:
text.ASV: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we shall also live with him;
text.WEB: But if we died with Christ, we believe that we will also live with him;

text.KJV: Knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death hath no more dominion over him.
text.ASV: knowing that Christ being raised from the dead dieth no more; death no more hath dominion over him.
text.WEB: knowing that Christ, being raised from the dead, dies no more. Death no more has dominion over him!

text.KJV: For in that he died, he died unto sin once: but in that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
text.ASV: For the death that he died, he died unto sin once: but the life that he liveth, he liveth unto God.
text.WEB: For the death that he died, he died to sin one time; but the life that he lives, he lives to God.

text.KJV: Likewise reckon ye also yourselves to be dead indeed unto sin, but alive unto God through Jesus Christ our Lord.
text.ASV: Even so reckon ye also yourselves to be dead unto sin, but alive unto God in Christ Jesus.
text.WEB: Thus consider yourselves also to be dead to sin, but alive to God in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text.KJV: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey it in the lusts thereof.
text.ASV: Let not sin therefore reign in your mortal body, that ye should obey the lusts thereof:
text.WEB: Therefore don’t let sin reign in your mortal body, that you should obey it in its lusts.

text.KJV: Neither yield ye your members as instruments of unrighteousness unto sin: but yield yourselves unto God, as those that are alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness unto God.
text.ASV: neither present your members unto sin `as' instruments of unrighteousness; but present yourselves unto God, as alive from the dead, and your members `as' instruments of righteousness unto God.
text.WEB: Also, do not present your members to sin as instruments of unrighteousness, but present yourselves to God, as alive from the dead, and your members as instruments of righteousness to God.

text.KJV: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under the law, but under grace.
text.ASV: For sin shall not have dominion over you: for ye are not under law, but under grace.
text.WEB: For sin will not have dominion over you. For you are not under law, but under grace.

text.KJV: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under the law, but under grace? God forbid.
text.ASV: What then? shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? God forbid.
text.WEB: What then? Shall we sin, because we are not under law, but under grace? May it never be!

text.KJV: Know ye not, that to whom ye yield yourselves servants to obey, his servants ye are to whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
text.ASV: Know ye not, that to whom ye present yourselves `as' servants unto obedience, his servants ye are whom ye obey; whether of sin unto death, or of obedience unto righteousness?
text.WEB: Don’t you know that when you present yourselves as servants and obey someone, you are the servants of whomever you obey; whether of sin to death, or of obedience to righteousness?

text.KJV: But God be thanked, that ye were the servants of sin, but ye have obeyed from the heart that form of doctrine which was delivered you.
text.ASV: But thanks be to God, that, whereas ye were servants of sin, ye became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching whereunto ye were delivered;
text.WEB: But thanks be to God, that, whereas you were bondservants of sin, you became obedient from the heart to that form of teaching to which you were delivered.

text.KJV: Being then made free from sin, ye became the servants of righteousness.
text.ASV: and being made free from sin, ye became servants of righteousness.
text.WEB: Being made free from sin, you became bondservants of righteousness.

text.KJV: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye have yielded your members servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity; even so now yield your members servants to righteousness unto holiness.
text.ASV: I speak after the manner of men because of the infirmity of your flesh: for as ye presented your members `as' servants to uncleanness and to iniquity unto iniquity, even so now present your members `as' servants to righteousness unto sanctification.
text.WEB: I speak in human terms because of the weakness of your flesh, for as you presented your members as servants to uncleanness and to wickedness upon wickedness, even so now present your members as servants to righteousness for sanctification.

text.KJV: For when ye were the servants of sin, ye were free from righteousness.
text.ASV: For when ye were servants of sin, ye were free in regard of righteousness.
text.WEB: For when you were servants of sin, you were free in regard to righteousness.

text.KJV: What fruit had ye then in those things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
text.ASV: What fruit then had ye at that time in the things whereof ye are now ashamed? for the end of those things is death.
text.WEB: What fruit then did you have at that time in the things of which you are now ashamed? For the end of those things is death.

text.KJV: But now being made free from sin, and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto holiness, and the end everlasting life.
text.ASV: But now being made free from sin and become servants to God, ye have your fruit unto sanctification, and the end eternal life.
text.WEB: But now, being made free from sin, and having become servants of God, you have your fruit of sanctification, and the result of eternal life.

text.KJV: For the wages of sin is death; but the gift of God is eternal life through Jesus Christ our Lord.
text.ASV: For the wages of sin is death; but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.WEB: For the wages of sin is death, but the free gift of God is eternal life in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text.KJV: Know ye not, brethren, (for I speak to them that know the law,) how that the law hath dominion over a man as long as he liveth?
text.ASV: Or are ye ignorant, brethren (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law hath dominion over a man for so long time as he liveth?
text.WEB: Or don’t you know, brothers (for I speak to men who know the law), that the law has dominion over a man for as long as he lives?

text.KJV: For the woman which hath an husband is bound by the law to her husband so long as he liveth; but if the husband be dead, she is loosed from the law of her husband.
text.ASV: For the woman that hath a husband is bound by law to the husband while he liveth; but if the husband die, she is discharged from the law of the husband.
text.WEB: For the woman that has a husband is bound by law to the husband while he lives, but if the husband dies, she is discharged from the law of the husband.

text.KJV: So then if, while her husband liveth, she be married to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if her husband be dead, she is free from that law; so that she is no adulteress, though she be married to another man.
text.ASV: So then if, while the husband liveth, she be joined to another man, she shall be called an adulteress: but if the husband die, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she be joined to another man.
text.WEB: So then if, while the husband lives, she is joined to another man, she would be called an adulteress. But if the husband dies, she is free from the law, so that she is no adulteress, though she is joined to another man.

text.KJV: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also are become dead to the law by the body of Christ; that ye should be married to another, even to him who is raised from the dead, that we should bring forth fruit unto God.
text.ASV: Wherefore, my brethren, ye also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ; that ye should be joined to another, `even' to him who was raised from the dead, that we might bring forth fruit unto God.
text.WEB: Therefore, my brothers, you also were made dead to the law through the body of Christ, that you would be joined to another, to him who was raised from the dead, that we might produce fruit to God.

text.KJV: For when we were in the flesh, the motions of sins, which were by the law, did work in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
text.ASV: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions, which were through the law, wrought in our members to bring forth fruit unto death.
text.WEB: For when we were in the flesh, the sinful passions which were through the law, worked in our members to bring out fruit to death.

text.KJV: But now we are delivered from the law, that being dead wherein we were held; that we should serve in newness of spirit, and not in the oldness of the letter.
text.ASV: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that wherein we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.
text.WEB: But now we have been discharged from the law, having died to that in which we were held; so that we serve in newness of the spirit, and not in oldness of the letter.

text.KJV: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Nay, I had not known sin, but by the law: for I had not known lust, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet.
text.ASV: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? God forbid. Howbeit, I had not known sin, except through the law: for I had not known coveting, except the law had said, Thou shalt not covet:
text.WEB: What shall we say then? Is the law sin? May it never be! However, I wouldn’t have known sin, except through the law. For I wouldn’t have known coveting, unless the law had said, “You shall not covet.”;

text.KJV: But sin, taking occasion by the commandment, wrought in me all manner of concupiscence. For without the law sin was dead.
text.ASV: but sin, finding occasion, wrought in me through the commandment all manner of coveting: for apart from the law sin `is' dead.
text.WEB: But sin, finding occasion through the commandment, produced in me all kinds of coveting. For apart from the law, sin is dead.

text.KJV: For I was alive without the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.
text.ASV: And I was alive apart from the law once: but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died;
text.WEB: I was alive apart from the law once, but when the commandment came, sin revived, and I died.

text.KJV: And the commandment, which was ordained to life, I found to be unto death.
text.ASV: and the commandment, which `was' unto life, this I found `to be' unto death:
text.WEB: The commandment, which was for life, this I found to be for death;

text.KJV: For sin, taking occasion by the commandment, deceived me, and by it slew me.
text.ASV: for sin, finding occasion, through the commandment beguiled me, and through it slew me.
text.WEB: for sin, finding occasion through the commandment, deceived me, and through it killed me.

text.KJV: Wherefore the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and just, and good.
text.ASV: So that the law is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.
text.WEB: Therefore the law indeed is holy, and the commandment holy, and righteous, and good.

text.KJV: Was then that which is good made death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might appear sin, working death in me by that which is good; that sin by the commandment might become exceeding sinful.
text.ASV: Did then that which is good become death unto me? God forbid. But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, by working death to me through that which is good; --that through the commandment sin might become exceeding sinful.
text.WEB: Did then that which is good become death to me? May it never be! But sin, that it might be shown to be sin, was producing death in me through that which is good; that through the commandment sin might become exceedingly sinful.

text.KJV: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
text.ASV: For we know that the law is spiritual: but I am carnal, sold under sin.
text.WEB: For we know that the law is spiritual, but I am fleshly, sold under sin.

text.KJV: For that which I do I allow not: for what I would, that do I not; but what I hate, that do I.
text.ASV: For that which I do I know not: for not what I would, that do I practise; but what I hate, that I do.
text.WEB: For I don’t know what I am doing. For I don’t practice what I desire to do; but what I hate, that I do.

text.KJV: If then I do that which I would not, I consent unto the law that it is good.
text.ASV: But if what I would not, that I do, I consent unto the law that it is good.
text.WEB: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, I consent to the law that it is good.

text.KJV: Now then it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
text.ASV: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwelleth in me.
text.WEB: So now it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

text.KJV: For I know that in me (that is, in my flesh,) dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me; but how to perform that which is good I find not.
text.ASV: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwelleth no good thing: for to will is present with me, but to do that which is good `is' not.
text.WEB: For I know that in me, that is, in my flesh, dwells no good thing. For desire is present with me, but I don’t find it doing that which is good.

text.KJV: For the good that I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I do.
text.ASV: For the good which I would I do not: but the evil which I would not, that I practise.
text.WEB: For the good which I desire, I don’t do; but the evil which I don’t desire, that I practice.

text.KJV: Now if I do that I would not, it is no more I that do it, but sin that dwelleth in me.
text.ASV: But if what I would not, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwelleth in me.
text.WEB: But if what I don’t desire, that I do, it is no more I that do it, but sin which dwells in me.

text.KJV: I find then a law, that, when I would do good, evil is present with me.
text.ASV: I find then the law, that, to me who would do good, evil is present.
text.WEB: I find then the law, that, to me, while I desire to do good, evil is present.

text.KJV: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
text.ASV: For I delight in the law of God after the inward man:
text.WEB: For I delight in God’s law after the inward man,

text.KJV: But I see another law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity to the law of sin which is in my members.
text.ASV: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.
text.WEB: but I see a different law in my members, warring against the law of my mind, and bringing me into captivity under the law of sin which is in my members.

text.KJV: O wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me from the body of this death?
text.ASV: Wretched man that I am! who shall deliver me out of the body of this death?
text.WEB: What a wretched man I am! Who will deliver me out of the body of this death?

text.KJV: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then with the mind I myself serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
text.ASV: I thank God through Jesus Christ our Lord. So then I of myself with the mind, indeed, serve the law of God; but with the flesh the law of sin.
text.WEB: I thank God through Jesus Christ, our Lord! So then with the mind, I myself serve God’s law, but with the flesh, the sin’s law.

text.KJV: There is therefore now no condemnation to them which are in Christ Jesus, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
text.ASV: There is therefore now no condemnation to them that are in Christ Jesus.
text.WEB: There is therefore now no condemnation to those who are in Christ Jesus, who don’t walk according to the flesh, but according to the Spirit.

text.KJV: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus hath made me free from the law of sin and death.
text.ASV: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.
text.WEB: For the law of the Spirit of life in Christ Jesus made me free from the law of sin and of death.

text.KJV: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh, and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
text.ASV: For what the law could not do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, condemned sin in the flesh:
text.WEB: For what the law couldn’t do, in that it was weak through the flesh, God did, sending his own Son in the likeness of sinful flesh and for sin, he condemned sin in the flesh;

text.KJV: That the righteousness of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
text.ASV: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.
text.WEB: that the ordinance of the law might be fulfilled in us, who walk not after the flesh, but after the Spirit.

text.KJV: For they that are after the flesh do mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
text.ASV: For they that are after the flesh mind the things of the flesh; but they that are after the Spirit the things of the Spirit.
text.WEB: For those who live according to the flesh set their minds on the things of the flesh, but those who live according to the Spirit, the things of the Spirit.

text.KJV: For to be carnally minded is death; but to be spiritually minded is life and peace.
text.ASV: For the mind of the flesh is death; but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace:
text.WEB: For the mind of the flesh is death, but the mind of the Spirit is life and peace;

text.KJV: Because the carnal mind is enmity against God: for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can be.
text.ASV: because the mind of the flesh is enmity against God; for it is not subject to the law of God, neither indeed can it be:
text.WEB: because the mind of the flesh is hostile towards God; for it is not subject to God’s law, neither indeed can it be.

text.KJV: So then they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
text.ASV: and they that are in the flesh cannot please God.
text.WEB: Those who are in the flesh can’t please God.

text.KJV: But ye are not in the flesh, but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwell in you. Now if any man have not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
text.ASV: But ye are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if so be that the Spirit of God dwelleth in you. But if any man hath not the Spirit of Christ, he is none of his.
text.WEB: But you are not in the flesh but in the Spirit, if it is so that the Spirit of God dwells in you. But if any man doesn’t have the Spirit of Christ, he is not his.

text.KJV: And if Christ be in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the Spirit is life because of righteousness.
text.ASV: And if Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin; but the spirit is life because of righteousness.
text.WEB: If Christ is in you, the body is dead because of sin, but the spirit is alive because of righteousness.

text.KJV: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwell in you, he that raised up Christ from the dead shall also quicken your mortal bodies by his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
text.ASV: But if the Spirit of him that raised up Jesus from the dead dwelleth in you, he that raised up Christ Jesus from the dead shall give life also to your mortal bodies through his Spirit that dwelleth in you.
text.WEB: But if the Spirit of him who raised up Jesus from the dead dwells in you, he who raised up Christ Jesus from the dead will also give life to your mortal bodies through his Spirit who dwells in you.

text.KJV: Therefore, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.
text.ASV: So then, brethren, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh:
text.WEB: So then, brothers, we are debtors, not to the flesh, to live after the flesh.

text.KJV: For if ye live after the flesh, ye shall die: but if ye through the Spirit do mortify the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
text.ASV: for if ye live after the flesh, ye must die; but if by the Spirit ye put to death the deeds of the body, ye shall live.
text.WEB: For if you live after the flesh, you must die; but if by the Spirit you put to death the deeds of the body, you will live.

text.KJV: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, they are the sons of God.
text.ASV: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are sons of God.
text.WEB: For as many as are led by the Spirit of God, these are children of God.

text.KJV: For ye have not received the spirit of bondage again to fear; but ye have received the Spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
text.ASV: For ye received not the spirit of bondage again unto fear; but ye received the spirit of adoption, whereby we cry, Abba, Father.
text.WEB: For you didn’t receive the spirit of bondage again to fear, but you received the Spirit of adoption, by whom we cry, “Abba! Father!”

text.KJV: The Spirit itself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are the children of God:
text.ASV: The Spirit himself beareth witness with our spirit, that we are children of God:
text.WEB: The Spirit himself testifies with our spirit that we are children of God;

text.KJV: And if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with him, that we may be also glorified together.
text.ASV: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint-heirs with Christ; if so be that we suffer with `him', that we may be also glorified with `him'.
text.WEB: and if children, then heirs; heirs of God, and joint heirs with Christ; if indeed we suffer with him, that we may also be glorified with him.

text.KJV: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed in us.
text.ASV: For I reckon that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which shall be revealed to us-ward.
text.WEB: For I consider that the sufferings of this present time are not worthy to be compared with the glory which will be revealed toward us.

text.KJV: For the earnest expectation of the creature waiteth for the manifestation of the sons of God.
text.ASV: For the earnest expectation of the creation waiteth for the revealing of the sons of God.
text.WEB: For the creation waits with eager expectation for the children of God to be revealed.

text.KJV: For the creature was made subject to vanity, not willingly, but by reason of him who hath subjected the same in hope,
text.ASV: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but by reason of him who subjected it, in hope
text.WEB: For the creation was subjected to vanity, not of its own will, but because of him who subjected it, in hope

text.KJV: Because the creature itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the glorious liberty of the children of God.
text.ASV: that the creation itself also shall be delivered from the bondage of corruption into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.
text.WEB: that the creation itself also will be delivered from the bondage of decay into the liberty of the glory of the children of God.

text.KJV: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
text.ASV: For we know that the whole creation groaneth and travaileth in pain together until now.
text.WEB: For we know that the whole creation groans and travails in pain together until now.

text.KJV: And not only they, but ourselves also, which have the firstfruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for the adoption, to wit, the redemption of our body.
text.ASV: And not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first-fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for `our' adoption, `to wit', the redemption of our body.
text.WEB: Not only so, but ourselves also, who have the first fruits of the Spirit, even we ourselves groan within ourselves, waiting for adoption, the redemption of our body.

text.KJV: For we are saved by hope: but hope that is seen is not hope: for what a man seeth, why doth he yet hope for?
text.ASV: For in hope were we saved: but hope that is seen is not hope: for who hopeth for that which he seeth?
text.WEB: For we were saved in hope, but hope that is seen is not hope. For who hopes for that which he sees?

text.KJV: But if we hope for that we see not, then do we with patience wait for it.
