text.ASV: But if we hope for that which we see not, `then' do we with patience wait for it.
text.WEB: But if we hope for that which we don’t see, we wait for it with patience.

text.KJV: Likewise the Spirit also helpeth our infirmities: for we know not what we should pray for as we ought: but the Spirit itself maketh intercession for us with groanings which cannot be uttered.
text.ASV: And in like manner the Spirit also helpeth our infirmity: for we know not how to pray as we ought; but the Spirit himself maketh intercession for `us' with groanings which cannot be uttered;
text.WEB: In the same way, the Spirit also helps our weaknesses, for we don’t know how to pray as we ought. But the Spirit himself makes intercession for us with groanings which can’t be uttered.

text.KJV: And he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to the will of God.
text.ASV: and he that searcheth the hearts knoweth what is the mind of the Spirit, because he maketh intercession for the saints according to `the will of' God.
text.WEB: He who searches the hearts knows what is on the Spirit’s mind, because he makes intercession for the saints according to God.

text.KJV: And we know that all things work together for good to them that love God, to them who are the called according to his purpose.
text.ASV: And we know that to them that love God all things work together for good, `even' to them that are called according to `his' purpose.
text.WEB: We know that all things work together for good for those who love God, to those who are called according to his purpose.

text.KJV: For whom he did foreknow, he also did predestinate to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren.
text.ASV: For whom he foreknew, he also foreordained `to be' conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brethren:
text.WEB: For whom he foreknew, he also predestined to be conformed to the image of his Son, that he might be the firstborn among many brothers.

text.KJV: Moreover whom he did predestinate, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
text.ASV: and whom he foreordained, them he also called: and whom he called, them he also justified: and whom he justified, them he also glorified.
text.WEB: Whom he predestined, those he also called. Whom he called, those he also justified. Whom he justified, those he also glorified.

text.KJV: What shall we then say to these things? If God be for us, who can be against us?
text.ASV: What then shall we say to these things? If God `is' for us, who `is' against us?
text.WEB: What then shall we say about these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?

text.KJV: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not with him also freely give us all things?
text.ASV: He that spared not his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how shall he not also with him freely give us all things?
text.WEB: He who didn’t spare his own Son, but delivered him up for us all, how would he not also with him freely give us all things?

text.KJV: Who shall lay any thing to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth.
text.ASV: Who shall lay anything to the charge of God's elect? It is God that justifieth;
text.WEB: Who could bring a charge against God’s chosen ones? It is God who justifies.

text.KJV: Who is he that condemneth? It is Christ that died, yea rather, that is risen again, who is even at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
text.ASV: who is he that condemneth? It is Christ Jesus that died, yea rather, that was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also maketh intercession for us.
text.WEB: Who is he who condemns? It is Christ who died, yes rather, who was raised from the dead, who is at the right hand of God, who also makes intercession for us.

text.KJV: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or distress, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
text.ASV: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? shall tribulation, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?
text.WEB: Who shall separate us from the love of Christ? Could oppression, or anguish, or persecution, or famine, or nakedness, or peril, or sword?

text.KJV: As it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; we are accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
text.ASV: Even as it is written, For thy sake we are killed all the day long; We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.
text.WEB: Even as it is written, “For your sake we are killed all day long. We were accounted as sheep for the slaughter.”

text.KJV: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
text.ASV: Nay, in all these things we are more than conquerors through him that loved us.
text.WEB: No, in all these things, we are more than conquerors through him who loved us.

text.KJV: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor powers, nor things present, nor things to come,
text.ASV: For I am persuaded, that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,
text.WEB: For I am persuaded that neither death, nor life, nor angels, nor principalities, nor things present, nor things to come, nor powers,

text.KJV: Nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.ASV: nor height, nor depth, nor any other creature, shall be able to separate us from the love of God, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.
text.WEB: nor height, nor depth, nor any other created thing, will be able to separate us from God’s love, which is in Christ Jesus our Lord.

text.KJV: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience also bearing me witness in the Holy Ghost,
text.ASV: I say the truth in Christ, I lie not, my conscience bearing witness with me in the Holy Spirit,
text.WEB: I tell the truth in Christ. I am not lying, my conscience testifying with me in the Holy Spirit,

text.KJV: That I have great heaviness and continual sorrow in my heart.
text.ASV: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.
text.WEB: that I have great sorrow and unceasing pain in my heart.

text.KJV: For I could wish that myself were accursed from Christ for my brethren, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
text.ASV: For I could wish that I myself were anathema from Christ for my brethren's sake, my kinsmen according to the flesh:
text.WEB: For I could wish that I myself were accursed from Christ for my brothers’ sake, my relatives according to the flesh,

text.KJV: Who are Israelites; to whom pertaineth the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service of God, and the promises;
text.ASV: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, and the glory, and the covenants, and the giving of the law, and the service `of God', and the promises;
text.WEB: who are Israelites; whose is the adoption, the glory, the covenants, the giving of the law, the service, and the promises;

text.KJV: Whose are the fathers, and of whom as concerning the flesh Christ came, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
text.ASV: whose are the fathers, and of whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God blessed for ever. Amen.
text.WEB: of whom are the fathers, and from whom is Christ as concerning the flesh, who is over all, God, blessed forever. Amen.

text.KJV: Not as though the word of God hath taken none effect. For they are not all Israel, which are of Israel:
text.ASV: But `it is' not as though the word of God hath come to nought. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel:
text.WEB: But it is not as though the word of God has come to nothing. For they are not all Israel, that are of Israel.

text.KJV: Neither, because they are the seed of Abraham, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
text.ASV: neither, because they are Abraham's seed, are they all children: but, In Isaac shall thy seed be called.
text.WEB: Neither, because they are Abraham’s offspring, are they all children. But, “your offspring will be accounted as from Isaac.”

text.KJV: That is, They which are the children of the flesh, these are not the children of God: but the children of the promise are counted for the seed.

text.KJV: Esaias also crieth concerning Israel, Though the number of the children of Israel be as the sand of the sea, a remnant shall be saved:

text.ASV: What shall we say then? That the Gentiles, who followed not after righteousness, attained to righteousness, even the righteousness which is of faith:

text.KJV: As it is written, Behold, I lay in Sion a stumblingstone and rock of offence: and whosoever believeth on him shall not be ashamed.
text.ASV: even as it is written, Behold, I lay in Zion a stone of stumbling and a rock of offence: And he that believeth on him shall not be put to shame.
text.WEB: even as it is written, “Behold, I lay in Zion a stumbling stone and a rock of offense; and no one who believes in him will be disappointed.”;

text.KJV: Brethren, my heart's desire and prayer to God for Israel is, that they might be saved.

text.WEB: Brothers, my heart’s desire and my prayer to God is for Israel, that they may be saved.

text.WEB: For I testify about them that they have a zeal for God, but not according to knowledge.

text.WEB: For Christ is the fulfillment of the law for righteousness to everyone who believes.

text.ASV: or, Who shall descend into the abyss? (That is, to bring Christ up from the dead.)

text.ASV: For the gifts and the calling of God are not repented of.
text.WEB: For the gifts and the calling of God are irrevocable.

text.KJV: For as ye in times past have not believed God, yet have now obtained mercy through their unbelief:
text.ASV: For as ye in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,
text.WEB: For as you in time past were disobedient to God, but now have obtained mercy by their disobedience,

text.KJV: Even so have these also now not believed, that through your mercy they also may obtain mercy.
text.ASV: even so have these also now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they also may now obtain mercy.
text.WEB: even so these also have now been disobedient, that by the mercy shown to you they may also obtain mercy.

text.KJV: For God hath concluded them all in unbelief, that he might have mercy upon all.
text.ASV: For God hath shut up all unto disobedience, that he might have mercy upon all.
text.WEB: For God has shut up all to disobedience, that he might have mercy on all.

text.KJV: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past finding out!
text.ASV: O the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! how unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!
text.WEB: Oh the depth of the riches both of the wisdom and the knowledge of God! How unsearchable are his judgments, and his ways past tracing out!

text.KJV: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
text.ASV: For who hath known the mind of the Lord? or who hath been his counsellor?
text.WEB: “For who has known the mind of the Lord? Or who has been his counselor?”

text.KJV: Or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
text.ASV: or who hath first given to him, and it shall be recompensed unto him again?
text.WEB: “Or who has first given to him, and it will be repaid to him again?”

text.KJV: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things: to whom be glory for ever. Amen.
text.ASV: For of him, and through him, and unto him, are all things. To him `be' the glory for ever. Amen.
text.WEB: For of him, and through him, and to him, are all things. To him be the glory for ever! Amen.

text.KJV: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, that ye present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable unto God, which is your reasonable service.
text.ASV: I beseech you therefore, brethren, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, `which is' your spiritual service.
text.WEB: Therefore I urge you, brothers, by the mercies of God, to present your bodies a living sacrifice, holy, acceptable to God, which is your spiritual service.

text.KJV: And be not conformed to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, that ye may prove what is that good, and acceptable, and perfect, will of God.
text.ASV: And be not fashioned according to this world: but be ye transformed by the renewing of your mind, and ye may prove what is the good and acceptable and perfect will of God.
text.WEB: Don’t be conformed to this world, but be transformed by the renewing of your mind, so that you may prove what is the good, well-pleasing, and perfect will of God.

text.KJV: For I say, through the grace given unto me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to every man the measure of faith.
text.ASV: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man that is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think as to think soberly, according as God hath dealt to each man a measure of faith.
text.WEB: For I say, through the grace that was given me, to every man who is among you, not to think of himself more highly than he ought to think; but to think reasonably, as God has apportioned to each person a measure of faith.

text.KJV: For as we have many members in one body, and all members have not the same office:
text.ASV: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members have not the same office:
text.WEB: For even as we have many members in one body, and all the members don’t have the same function,

text.KJV: So we, being many, are one body in Christ, and every one members one of another.
text.ASV: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and severally members one of another.
text.WEB: so we, who are many, are one body in Christ, and individually members one of another.

text.KJV: Having then gifts differing according to the grace that is given to us, whether prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of faith;
text.ASV: And having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, whether prophecy, `let us prophesy' according to the proportion of our faith;
text.WEB: Having gifts differing according to the grace that was given to us, if prophecy, let us prophesy according to the proportion of our faith;

text.KJV: Or ministry, let us wait on our ministering: or he that teacheth, on teaching;
text.ASV: or ministry, `let us give ourselves' to our ministry; or he that teacheth, to his teaching;
text.WEB: or service, let us give ourselves to service; or he who teaches, to his teaching;

text.KJV: Or he that exhorteth, on exhortation: he that giveth, let him do it with simplicity; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that sheweth mercy, with cheerfulness.
text.ASV: or he that exhorteth, to his exhorting: he that giveth, `let him do it' with liberality; he that ruleth, with diligence; he that showeth mercy, with cheerfulness.
text.WEB: or he who exhorts, to his exhorting: he who gives, let him do it with generosity; he who rules, with diligence; he who shows mercy, with cheerfulness.

text.KJV: Let love be without dissimulation. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
text.ASV: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil; cleave to that which is good.
text.WEB: Let love be without hypocrisy. Abhor that which is evil. Cling to that which is good.

text.KJV: Be kindly affectioned one to another with brotherly love; in honour preferring one another;
text.ASV: In love of the brethren be tenderly affectioned one to another; in honor preferring one another;
text.WEB: In love of the brothers be tenderly affectionate to one another; in honor preferring one another;

text.KJV: Not slothful in business; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
text.ASV: in diligence not slothful; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;
text.WEB: not lagging in diligence; fervent in spirit; serving the Lord;

text.KJV: Rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing instant in prayer;
text.ASV: rejoicing in hope; patient in tribulation; continuing stedfastly in prayer;
text.WEB: rejoicing in hope; enduring in troubles; continuing steadfastly in prayer;

text.KJV: Distributing to the necessity of saints; given to hospitality.
text.ASV: communicating to the necessities of the saints; given to hospitality.
text.WEB: contributing to the needs of the saints; given to hospitality.

text.KJV: Bless them which persecute you: bless, and curse not.
text.ASV: Bless them that persecute you; bless, and curse not.
text.WEB: Bless those who persecute you; bless, and don’t curse.

text.KJV: Rejoice with them that do rejoice, and weep with them that weep.
text.ASV: Rejoice with them that rejoice; weep with them that weep.
text.WEB: Rejoice with those who rejoice. Weep with those who weep.

text.KJV: Be of the same mind one toward another. Mind not high things, but condescend to men of low estate. Be not wise in your own conceits.
text.ASV: Be of the same mind one toward another. Set not your mind on high things, but condescend to things that are lowly. Be not wise in your own conceits.
text.WEB: Be of the same mind one toward another. Don’t set your mind on high things, but associate with the humble. Don’t be wise in your own conceits.

text.KJV: Recompense to no man evil for evil. Provide things honest in the sight of all men.
text.ASV: Render to no man evil for evil. Take thought for things honorable in the sight of all men.
text.WEB: Repay no one evil for evil. Respect what is honorable in the sight of all men.

text.KJV: If it be possible, as much as lieth in you, live peaceably with all men.
text.ASV: If it be possible, as much as in you lieth, be at peace with all men.
text.WEB: If it is possible, as much as it is up to you, be at peace with all men.

text.KJV: Dearly beloved, avenge not yourselves, but rather give place unto wrath: for it is written, Vengeance is mine; I will repay, saith the Lord.
text.ASV: Avenge not yourselves, beloved, but give place unto the wrath `of God': for it is written, Vengeance belongeth unto me; I will recompense, saith the Lord.
text.WEB: Don’t seek revenge yourselves, beloved, but give place to God’s wrath. For it is written, “Vengeance belongs to me; I will repay, says the Lord.”

text.KJV: Therefore if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire on his head.
text.ASV: But if thine enemy hunger, feed him; if he thirst, give him to drink: for in so doing thou shalt heap coals of fire upon his head.
text.WEB: Therefore “If your enemy is hungry, feed him. If he is thirsty, give him a drink; for in doing so, you will heap coals of fire on his head.”

text.KJV: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
text.ASV: Be not overcome of evil, but overcome evil with good.
text.WEB: Don’t be overcome by evil, but overcome evil with good.

text.KJV: Let every soul be subject unto the higher powers. For there is no power but of God: the powers that be are ordained of God.
text.ASV: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher powers: for there is no power but of God; and the `powers' that be are ordained of God.
text.WEB: Let every soul be in subjection to the higher authorities, for there is no authority except from God, and those who exist are ordained by God.

text.KJV: Whosoever therefore resisteth the power, resisteth the ordinance of God: and they that resist shall receive to themselves damnation.
text.ASV: Therefore he that resisteth the power, withstandeth the ordinance of God: and they that withstand shall receive to themselves judgment.
text.WEB: Therefore he who resists the authority, withstands the ordinance of God; and those who withstand will receive to themselves judgment.

text.KJV: For rulers are not a terror to good works, but to the evil. Wilt thou then not be afraid of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise of the same:
text.ASV: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. And wouldest thou have no fear of the power? do that which is good, and thou shalt have praise from the same:
text.WEB: For rulers are not a terror to the good work, but to the evil. Do you desire to have no fear of the authority? Do that which is good, and you will have praise from the same,

text.KJV: For he is the minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is the minister of God, a revenger to execute wrath upon him that doeth evil.
text.ASV: for he is a minister of God to thee for good. But if thou do that which is evil, be afraid; for he beareth not the sword in vain: for he is a minister of God, an avenger for wrath to him that doeth evil.
text.WEB: for he is a servant of God to you for good. But if you do that which is evil, be afraid, for he doesn’t bear the sword in vain; for he is a servant of God, an avenger for wrath to him who does evil.

text.KJV: Wherefore ye must needs be subject, not only for wrath, but also for conscience sake.
text.ASV: Wherefore `ye' must needs be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience' sake.
text.WEB: Therefore you need to be in subjection, not only because of the wrath, but also for conscience’ sake.

text.KJV: For for this cause pay ye tribute also: for they are God's ministers, attending continually upon this very thing.
text.ASV: For this cause ye pay tribute also; for they are ministers of God's service, attending continually upon this very thing.
text.WEB: For this reason you also pay taxes, for they are servants of God’s service, attending continually on this very thing.

text.KJV: Render therefore to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute is due; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honour to whom honour.
text.ASV: Render to all their dues: tribute to whom tribute `is due'; custom to whom custom; fear to whom fear; honor to whom honor.
text.WEB: Therefore give everyone what you owe: if you owe taxes, pay taxes; if customs, then customs; if respect, then respect; if honor, then honor.

text.KJV: Owe no man any thing, but to love one another: for he that loveth another hath fulfilled the law.
text.ASV: Owe no man anything, save to love one another: for he that loveth his neighbor hath fulfilled the law.
text.WEB: Owe no one anything, except to love one another; for he who loves his neighbor has fulfilled the law.

text.KJV: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not bear false witness, Thou shalt not covet; and if there be any other commandment, it is briefly comprehended in this saying, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbour as thyself.
text.ASV: For this, Thou shalt not commit adultery, Thou shalt not kill, Thou shalt not steal, Thou shalt not covet, and if there be any other commandment, it is summed up in this word, namely, Thou shalt love thy neighbor as thyself.
text.WEB: For the commandments, “You shall not commit adultery,” “You shall not murder,” “You shall not steal,” “You shall not covet,” ,; , and whatever other commandments there are, are all summed up in this saying, namely, “You shall love your neighbor as yourself.”

text.KJV: Love worketh no ill to his neighbour: therefore love is the fulfilling of the law.
text.ASV: Love worketh no ill to his neighbor: love therefore is the fulfilment of the law.
text.WEB: Love doesn’t harm a neighbor. Love therefore is the fulfillment of the law.

text.KJV: And that, knowing the time, that now it is high time to awake out of sleep: for now is our salvation nearer than when we believed.
text.ASV: And this, knowing the season, that already it is time for you to awake out of sleep: for now is salvation nearer to us than when we `first' believed.
text.WEB: Do this, knowing the time, that it is already time for you to awaken out of sleep, for salvation is now nearer to us than when we first believed.

text.KJV: The night is far spent, the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armour of light.
text.ASV: The night is far spent, and the day is at hand: let us therefore cast off the works of darkness, and let us put on the armor of light.
text.WEB: The night is far gone, and the day is near. Let’s therefore throw off the deeds of darkness, and let’s put on the armor of light.

text.KJV: Let us walk honestly, as in the day; not in rioting and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and envying.
text.ASV: Let us walk becomingly, as in the day; not in revelling and drunkenness, not in chambering and wantonness, not in strife and jealousy.
text.WEB: Let us walk properly, as in the day; not in reveling and drunkenness, not in sexual promiscuity and lustful acts, and not in strife and jealousy.

text.KJV: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to fulfil the lusts thereof.
text.ASV: But put ye on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make not provision for the flesh, to `fulfil' the lusts `thereof'.
text.WEB: But put on the Lord Jesus Christ, and make no provision for the flesh, for its lusts.

text.KJV: Him that is weak in the faith receive ye, but not to doubtful disputations.
text.ASV: But him that is weak in faith receive ye, `yet' not for decision of scruples.
text.WEB: Now accept one who is weak in faith, but not for disputes over opinions.

text.KJV: For one believeth that he may eat all things: another, who is weak, eateth herbs.
text.ASV: One man hath faith to eat all things: but he that is weak eateth herbs.
text.WEB: One man has faith to eat all things, but he who is weak eats only vegetables.

text.KJV: Let not him that eateth despise him that eateth not; and let not him which eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
text.ASV: Let not him that eateth set at nought him that eateth not; and let not him that eateth not judge him that eateth: for God hath received him.
text.WEB: Don’t let him who eats despise him who doesn’t eat. Don’t let him who doesn’t eat judge him who eats, for God has accepted him.

text.KJV: Who art thou that judgest another man's servant? to his own master he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be holden up: for God is able to make him stand.
text.ASV: Who art thou that judgest the servant of another? to his own lord he standeth or falleth. Yea, he shall be made to stand; for the Lord hath power to make him stand.
text.WEB: Who are you who judge another’s servant? To his own lord he stands or falls. Yes, he will be made to stand, for God has power to make him stand.

text.KJV: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day alike. Let every man be fully persuaded in his own mind.
text.ASV: One man esteemeth one day above another: another esteemeth every day `alike'. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.
text.WEB: One man esteems one day as more important. Another esteems every day alike. Let each man be fully assured in his own mind.

text.KJV: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord; and he that regardeth not the day, to the Lord he doth not regard it. He that eateth, eateth to the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, to the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
text.ASV: He that regardeth the day, regardeth it unto the Lord: and he that eateth, eateth unto the Lord, for he giveth God thanks; and he that eateth not, unto the Lord he eateth not, and giveth God thanks.
text.WEB: He who observes the day, observes it to the Lord; and he who does not observe the day, to the Lord he does not observe it. He who eats, eats to the Lord, for he gives God thanks. He who doesn’t eat, to the Lord he doesn’t eat, and gives God thanks.

text.KJV: For none of us liveth to himself, and no man dieth to himself.
text.ASV: For none of us liveth to himself, and none dieth to himself.
text.WEB: For none of us lives to himself, and none dies to himself.

text.KJV: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; and whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
text.ASV: For whether we live, we live unto the Lord; or whether we die, we die unto the Lord: whether we live therefore, or die, we are the Lord's.
text.WEB: For if we live, we live to the Lord. Or if we die, we die to the Lord. If therefore we live or die, we are the Lord’s.

text.KJV: For to this end Christ both died, and rose, and revived, that he might be Lord both of the dead and living.
text.ASV: For to this end Christ died and lived `again', that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.
text.WEB: For to this end Christ died, rose, and lived again, that he might be Lord of both the dead and the living.

text.KJV: But why dost thou judge thy brother? or why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.
text.ASV: But thou, why dost thou judge thy brother? or thou again, why dost thou set at nought thy brother? for we shall all stand before the judgment-seat of God.
text.WEB: But you, why do you judge your brother? Or you again, why do you despise your brother? For we will all stand before the judgment seat of Christ.

text.KJV: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, every knee shall bow to me, and every tongue shall confess to God.
text.ASV: For it is written, As I live, saith the Lord, to me every knee shall bow, And every tongue shall confess to God.
text.WEB: For it is written, “‘As I live,’ says the Lord, ‘to me every knee will bow. Every tongue will confess to God.’”

text.KJV: So then every one of us shall give account of himself to God.
text.ASV: So then each one of us shall give account of himself to God.
text.WEB: So then each one of us will give account of himself to God.

text.KJV: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock or an occasion to fall in his brother's way.
text.ASV: Let us not therefore judge one another any more: but judge ye this rather, that no man put a stumblingblock in his brother's way, or an occasion of falling.
text.WEB: Therefore let’s not judge one another any more, but judge this rather, that no man put a stumbling block in his brother’s way, or an occasion for falling.

text.KJV: I know, and am persuaded by the Lord Jesus, that there is nothing unclean of itself: but to him that esteemeth any thing to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
text.ASV: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself: save that to him who accounteth anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.
text.WEB: I know, and am persuaded in the Lord Jesus, that nothing is unclean of itself; except that to him who considers anything to be unclean, to him it is unclean.

text.KJV: But if thy brother be grieved with thy meat, now walkest thou not charitably. Destroy not him with thy meat, for whom Christ died.
text.ASV: For if because of meat thy brother is grieved, thou walkest no longer in love. Destroy not with thy meat him for whom Christ died.
text.WEB: Yet if because of food your brother is grieved, you walk no longer in love. Don’t destroy with your food him for whom Christ died.

text.KJV: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
text.ASV: Let not then your good be evil spoken of:
text.WEB: Then don’t let your good be slandered,

text.KJV: For the kingdom of God is not meat and drink; but righteousness, and peace, and joy in the Holy Ghost.
text.ASV: for the kingdom of God is not eating and drinking, but righteousness and peace and joy in the Holy Spirit.
text.WEB: for God’s Kingdom is not eating and drinking, but righteousness, peace, and joy in the Holy Spirit.

text.KJV: For he that in these things serveth Christ is acceptable to God, and approved of men.
text.ASV: For he that herein serveth Christ is well-pleasing to God, and approved of men.
text.WEB: For he who serves Christ in these things is acceptable to God and approved by men.

text.KJV: Let us therefore follow after the things which make for peace, and things wherewith one may edify another.
text.ASV: So then let us follow after things which make for peace, and things whereby we may edify one another.
text.WEB: So then, let us follow after things which make for peace, and things by which we may build one another up.

text.KJV: For meat destroy not the work of God. All things indeed are pure; but it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
text.ASV: Overthrow not for meat's sake the work of God. All things indeed are clean; howbeit it is evil for that man who eateth with offence.
text.WEB: Don’t overthrow God’s work for food’s sake. All things indeed are clean, however it is evil for that man who creates a stumbling block by eating.

text.KJV: It is good neither to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor any thing whereby thy brother stumbleth, or is offended, or is made weak.
text.ASV: It is good not to eat flesh, nor to drink wine, nor `to do anything' whereby thy brother stumbleth.
text.WEB: It is good to not eat meat, drink wine, nor do anything by which your brother stumbles, is offended, or is made weak.

text.KJV: Hast thou faith? have it to thyself before God. Happy is he that condemneth not himself in that thing which he alloweth.
text.ASV: The faith which thou hast, have thou to thyself before God. Happy is he that judgeth not himself in that which he approveth.
text.WEB: Do you have faith? Have it to yourself before God. Happy is he who doesn’t judge himself in that which he approves.

text.KJV: And he that doubteth is damned if he eat, because he eateth not of faith: for whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
text.ASV: But he that doubteth is condemned if he eat, because `he eateth' not of faith; and whatsoever is not of faith is sin.
text.WEB: But he who doubts is condemned if he eats, because it isn’t of faith; and whatever is not of faith is sin.

text.KJV: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
text.ASV: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
text.WEB: Now to him who is able to establish you according to my Good News and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which has been kept secret through long ages,

text.KJV: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
text.ASV: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
text.WEB: but now is revealed, and by the Scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known for obedience of faith to all the nations;

text.KJV: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
text.ASV: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
text.WEB: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory forever! Amen. as verses

text.KJV: We then that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
text.ASV: Now we that are strong ought to bear the infirmities of the weak, and not to please ourselves.
text.WEB: Now we who are strong ought to bear the weaknesses of the weak, and not to please ourselves.

text.KJV: Let every one of us please his neighbour for his good to edification.
text.ASV: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, unto edifying.
text.WEB: Let each one of us please his neighbor for that which is good, to be building him up.

text.KJV: For even Christ pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell on me.
text.ASV: For Christ also pleased not himself; but, as it is written, The reproaches of them that reproached thee fell upon me.
text.WEB: For even Christ didn’t please himself. But, as it is written, “The reproaches of those who reproached you fell on me.”

text.KJV: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that we through patience and comfort of the scriptures might have hope.
text.ASV: For whatsoever things were written aforetime were written for our learning, that through patience and through comfort of the scriptures we might have hope.
text.WEB: For whatever things were written before were written for our learning, that through perseverance and through encouragement of the Scriptures we might have hope.

text.KJV: Now the God of patience and consolation grant you to be likeminded one toward another according to Christ Jesus:
text.ASV: Now the God of patience and of comfort grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus:
text.WEB: Now the God of perseverance and of encouragement grant you to be of the same mind one with another according to Christ Jesus,

text.KJV: That ye may with one mind and one mouth glorify God, even the Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text.ASV: that with one accord ye may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.
text.WEB: that with one accord you may with one mouth glorify the God and Father of our Lord Jesus Christ.

text.KJV: Wherefore receive ye one another, as Christ also received us to the glory of God.
text.ASV: Wherefore receive ye one another, even as Christ also received you, to the glory of God.
text.WEB: Therefore accept one another, even as Christ also accepted you, to the glory of God.

text.KJV: Now I say that Jesus Christ was a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, to confirm the promises made unto the fathers:
text.ASV: For I say that Christ hath been made a minister of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises `given' unto the fathers,
text.WEB: Now I say that Christ has been made a servant of the circumcision for the truth of God, that he might confirm the promises given to the fathers,

text.KJV: And that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, For this cause I will confess to thee among the Gentiles, and sing unto thy name.
text.ASV: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy; as it is written, Therefore will I give praise unto thee among the Gentiles, And sing unto thy name.
text.WEB: and that the Gentiles might glorify God for his mercy. As it is written, “Therefore will I give praise to you among the Gentiles, and sing to your name.”;

text.KJV: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
text.ASV: And again he saith, Rejoice, ye Gentiles, with his people.
text.WEB: Again he says, “Rejoice, you Gentiles, with his people.”

text.KJV: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; and laud him, all ye people.
text.ASV: And again, Praise the Lord, all ye Gentiles; And let all the peoples praise him.
text.WEB: Again, “Praise the Lord, all you Gentiles! Let all the peoples praise him.”

text.KJV: And again, Esaias saith, There shall be a root of Jesse, and he that shall rise to reign over the Gentiles; in him shall the Gentiles trust.
text.ASV: And again, Isaiah saith, There shall be the root of Jesse, And he that ariseth to rule over the Gentiles; On him shall the Gentiles hope.
text.WEB: Again, Isaiah says, “There will be the root of Jesse, he who arises to rule over the Gentiles; in him the Gentiles will hope.”

text.KJV: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, through the power of the Holy Ghost.
text.ASV: Now the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that ye may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.
text.WEB: Now may the God of hope fill you with all joy and peace in believing, that you may abound in hope, in the power of the Holy Spirit.

text.KJV: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye also are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
text.ASV: And I myself also am persuaded of you, my brethren, that ye yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish one another.
text.WEB: I myself am also persuaded about you, my brothers, that you yourselves are full of goodness, filled with all knowledge, able also to admonish others.

text.KJV: Nevertheless, brethren, I have written the more boldly unto you in some sort, as putting you in mind, because of the grace that is given to me of God,
text.ASV: But I write the more boldly unto you in some measure, as putting you again in remembrance, because of the grace that was given me of God,
text.WEB: But I write the more boldly to you in part, as reminding you, because of the grace that was given to me by God,

text.KJV: That I should be the minister of Jesus Christ to the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Ghost.
text.ASV: that I should be a minister of Christ Jesus unto the Gentiles, ministering the gospel of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, being sanctified by the Holy Spirit.
text.WEB: that I should be a servant of Christ Jesus to the Gentiles, serving as a priest of the Good News of God, that the offering up of the Gentiles might be made acceptable, sanctified by the Holy Spirit.

text.KJV: I have therefore whereof I may glory through Jesus Christ in those things which pertain to God.
text.ASV: I have therefore my glorifying in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.
text.WEB: I have therefore my boasting in Christ Jesus in things pertaining to God.

text.KJV: For I will not dare to speak of any of those things which Christ hath not wrought by me, to make the Gentiles obedient, by word and deed,
text.ASV: For I will not dare to speak of any things save those which Christ wrought through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,
text.WEB: For I will not dare to speak of any things except those which Christ worked through me, for the obedience of the Gentiles, by word and deed,

text.KJV: Through mighty signs and wonders, by the power of the Spirit of God; so that from Jerusalem, and round about unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ.
text.ASV: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of the Holy Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and round about even unto Illyricum, I have fully preached the gospel of Christ;
text.WEB: in the power of signs and wonders, in the power of God’s Spirit; so that from Jerusalem, and around as far as to Illyricum, I have fully preached the Good News of Christ;

text.KJV: Yea, so have I strived to preach the gospel, not where Christ was named, lest I should build upon another man's foundation:
text.ASV: yea, making it my aim so to preach the gospel, not where Christ was `already' named, that I might not build upon another man's foundation;
text.WEB: yes, making it my aim to preach the Good News, not where Christ was already named, that I might not build on another’s foundation.

text.KJV: But as it is written, To whom he was not spoken of, they shall see: and they that have not heard shall understand.
text.ASV: but, as it is written, They shall see, to whom no tidings of him came, And they who have not heard shall understand.
text.WEB: But, as it is written, “They will see, to whom no news of him came. They who haven’t heard will understand.”

text.KJV: For which cause also I have been much hindered from coming to you.
text.ASV: Wherefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you:
text.WEB: Therefore also I was hindered these many times from coming to you,

text.KJV: But now having no more place in these parts, and having a great desire these many years to come unto you;
text.ASV: but now, having no more any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come unto you,
text.WEB: but now, no longer having any place in these regions, and having these many years a longing to come to you,

text.KJV: Whensoever I take my journey into Spain, I will come to you: for I trust to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first I be somewhat filled with your company.
text.ASV: whensoever I go unto Spain (for I hope to see you in my journey, and to be brought on my way thitherward by you, if first in some measure I shall have been satisfied with your company)--
text.WEB: whenever I travel to Spain, I will come to you. For I hope to see you on my journey, and to be helped on my way there by you, if first I may enjoy your company for a while.

text.KJV: But now I go unto Jerusalem to minister unto the saints.
text.ASV: but now, I `say', I go unto Jerusalem, ministering unto the saints.
text.WEB: But now, I say, I am going to Jerusalem, serving the saints.

text.KJV: For it hath pleased them of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor saints which are at Jerusalem.
text.ASV: For it hath been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints that are at Jerusalem.
text.WEB: For it has been the good pleasure of Macedonia and Achaia to make a certain contribution for the poor among the saints who are at Jerusalem.

text.KJV: It hath pleased them verily; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, their duty is also to minister unto them in carnal things.
text.ASV: Yea, it hath been their good pleasure; and their debtors they are. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it `to them' also to minister unto them in carnal things.
text.WEB: Yes, it has been their good pleasure, and they are their debtors. For if the Gentiles have been made partakers of their spiritual things, they owe it to them also to serve them in fleshly things.

text.KJV: When therefore I have performed this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will come by you into Spain.
text.ASV: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by you unto Spain.
text.WEB: When therefore I have accomplished this, and have sealed to them this fruit, I will go on by way of you to Spain.

text.KJV: And I am sure that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of the gospel of Christ.
text.ASV: And I know that, when I come unto you, I shall come in the fulness of the blessing of Christ.
text.WEB: I know that, when I come to you, I will come in the fullness of the blessing of the Good News of Christ.

text.KJV: Now I beseech you, brethren, for the Lord Jesus Christ's sake, and for the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
text.ASV: Now I beseech you, brethren, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that ye strive together with me in your prayers to God for me;
text.WEB: Now I beg you, brothers, by our Lord Jesus Christ, and by the love of the Spirit, that you strive together with me in your prayers to God for me,

text.KJV: That I may be delivered from them that do not believe in Judaea; and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be accepted of the saints;
text.ASV: that I may be delivered from them that are disobedient in Judaea, and `that' my ministration which `I have' for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;
text.WEB: that I may be delivered from those who are disobedient in Judea, and that my service which I have for Jerusalem may be acceptable to the saints;

text.KJV: That I may come unto you with joy by the will of God, and may with you be refreshed.
text.ASV: that I may come unto you in joy through the will of God, and together with you find rest.
text.WEB: that I may come to you in joy through the will of God, and together with you, find rest.

text.KJV: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
text.ASV: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.
text.WEB: Now the God of peace be with you all. Amen.

text.KJV: I commend unto you Phebe our sister, which is a servant of the church which is at Cenchrea:
text.ASV: I commend unto you Phoebe our sister, who is a servant of the church that is at Cenchreae:
text.WEB: I commend to you Phoebe, our sister, who is a servant of the assembly that is at Cenchreae,

text.KJV: That ye receive her in the Lord, as becometh saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever business she hath need of you: for she hath been a succourer of many, and of myself also.
text.ASV: that ye receive her in the Lord, worthily of the saints, and that ye assist her in whatsoever matter she may have need of you: for she herself also hath been a helper of many, and of mine own self.
text.WEB: that you receive her in the Lord, in a way worthy of the saints, and that you assist her in whatever matter she may need from you, for she herself also has been a helper of many, and of my own self.

text.KJV: Greet Priscilla and Aquila my helpers in Christ Jesus:
text.ASV: Salute Prisca and Aquila my fellow-workers in Christ Jesus,
text.WEB: Greet Prisca and Aquila, my fellow workers in Christ Jesus,

text.KJV: Who have for my life laid down their own necks: unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles.
text.ASV: who for my life laid down their own necks; unto whom not only I give thanks, but also all the churches of the Gentiles:
text.WEB: who for my life, laid down their own necks; to whom not only I give thanks, but also all the assemblies of the Gentiles.

text.KJV: Likewise greet the church that is in their house. Salute my well-beloved Epaenetus, who is the firstfruits of Achaia unto Christ.
text.ASV: and `salute' the church that is in their house. Salute Epaenetus my beloved, who is the first-fruits of Asia unto Christ.
text.WEB: Greet the assembly that is in their house. Greet Epaenetus, my beloved, who is the first fruits of Achaia to Christ.

text.KJV: Greet Mary, who bestowed much labour on us.
text.ASV: Salute Mary, who bestowed much labor on you.
text.WEB: Greet Mary, who labored much for us.

text.KJV: Salute Andronicus and Junia, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also were in Christ before me.
text.ASV: Salute Andronicus and Junias, my kinsmen, and my fellow-prisoners, who are of note among the apostles, who also have been in Christ before me.
text.WEB: Greet Andronicus and Junia, my relatives and my fellow prisoners, who are notable among the apostles, who were also in Christ before me.

text.KJV: Greet Amplias my beloved in the Lord.
text.ASV: Salute Ampliatus my beloved in the Lord.
text.WEB: Greet Amplias, my beloved in the Lord.

text.KJV: Salute Urbane, our helper in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
text.ASV: Salute Urbanus our fellow-worker in Christ, and Stachys my beloved.
text.WEB: Greet Urbanus, our fellow worker in Christ, and Stachys, my beloved.

text.KJV: Salute Apelles approved in Christ. Salute them which are of Aristobulus' household.
text.ASV: Salute Apelles the approved in Christ. Salute them that are of the `household' of Aristobulus.
text.WEB: Greet Apelles, the approved in Christ. Greet those who are of the household of Aristobulus.

text.KJV: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Greet them that be of the household of Narcissus, which are in the Lord.
text.ASV: Salute Herodion my kinsman. Salute them of the `household' of Narcissus, that are in the Lord.
text.WEB: Greet Herodion, my kinsman. Greet them of the household of Narcissus, who are in the Lord.

text.KJV: Salute Tryphena and Tryphosa, who labour in the Lord. Salute the beloved Persis, which laboured much in the Lord.
text.ASV: Salute Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Salute Persis the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.
text.WEB: Greet Tryphaena and Tryphosa, who labor in the Lord. Greet Persis, the beloved, who labored much in the Lord.

text.KJV: Salute Rufus chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
text.ASV: Salute Rufus the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.
text.WEB: Greet Rufus, the chosen in the Lord, and his mother and mine.

text.KJV: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermas, Patrobas, Hermes, and the brethren which are with them.
text.ASV: Salute Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brethren that are with them.
text.WEB: Greet Asyncritus, Phlegon, Hermes, Patrobas, Hermas, and the brothers who are with them.

text.KJV: Salute Philologus, and Julia, Nereus, and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints which are with them.
text.ASV: Salute Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints that are with them.
text.WEB: Greet Philologus and Julia, Nereus and his sister, and Olympas, and all the saints who are with them.

text.KJV: Salute one another with an holy kiss. The churches of Christ salute you.
text.ASV: Salute one another with a holy kiss. All the churches of Christ salute you.
text.WEB: Greet one another with a holy kiss. The assemblies of Christ greet you.

text.KJV: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them which cause divisions and offences contrary to the doctrine which ye have learned; and avoid them.
text.ASV: Now I beseech you, brethren, mark them that are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which ye learned: and turn away from them.
text.WEB: Now I beg you, brothers, look out for those who are causing the divisions and occasions of stumbling, contrary to the doctrine which you learned, and turn away from them.

text.KJV: For they that are such serve not our Lord Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by good words and fair speeches deceive the hearts of the simple.
text.ASV: For they that are such serve not our Lord Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and fair speech they beguile the hearts of the innocent.
text.WEB: For those who are such don’t serve our Lord, Jesus Christ, but their own belly; and by their smooth and flattering speech, they deceive the hearts of the innocent.

text.KJV: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I am glad therefore on your behalf: but yet I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple concerning evil.
text.ASV: For your obedience is come abroad unto all men. I rejoice therefore over you: but I would have you wise unto that which is good, and simple unto that which is evil.
text.WEB: For your obedience has become known to all. I rejoice therefore over you. But I desire to have you wise in that which is good, but innocent in that which is evil.

text.KJV: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you. Amen.
text.ASV: And the God of peace shall bruise Satan under your feet shortly. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.
text.WEB: And the God of peace will quickly crush Satan under your feet. The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you.

text.KJV: Timotheus my workfellow, and Lucius, and Jason, and Sosipater, my kinsmen, salute you.
text.ASV: Timothy my fellow-worker saluteth you; and Lucius and Jason and Sosipater, my kinsmen.
text.WEB: Timothy, my fellow worker, greets you, as do Lucius, Jason, and Sosipater, my relatives.

text.KJV: I Tertius, who wrote this epistle, salute you in the Lord.
text.ASV: I Tertius, who write the epistle, salute you in the Lord.
text.WEB: I, Tertius, who write the letter, greet you in the Lord.

text.KJV: Gaius mine host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the chamberlain of the city saluteth you, and Quartus a brother.
text.ASV: Gaius my host, and of the whole church, saluteth you. Erastus the treasurer of the city saluteth you, and Quartus the brother.
text.WEB: Gaius, my host and host of the whole assembly, greets you. Erastus, the treasurer of the city, greets you, as does Quartus, the brother.

text.KJV: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.
text.ASV: `The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all. Amen.'
text.WEB: The grace of our Lord Jesus Christ be with you all! Amen.

text.KJV: Now to him that is of power to stablish you according to my gospel, and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery, which was kept secret since the world began,
text.ASV: Now to him that is able to establish you according to my gospel and the preaching of Jesus Christ, according to the revelation of the mystery which hath been kept in silence through times eternal,
text.WEB: at the end of Romans instead of at the end of chapter and numbers these verses

text.KJV: But now is made manifest, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the everlasting God, made known to all nations for the obedience of faith:
text.ASV: but now is manifested, and by the scriptures of the prophets, according to the commandment of the eternal God, is made known unto all the nations unto obedience of faith:
text.WEB: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]

text.KJV: To God only wise, be glory through Jesus Christ for ever. Amen.
text.ASV: to the only wise God, through Jesus Christ, to whom be the glory for ever. Amen.
text.WEB: [This verse is not included in this translation's manuscript tradition.]
